bilingual.notes: Rule 8710.4150 — bilingual/bicultural is an add-on requiring a prerequisite license (elementary or 5–12/7–12 in math, science, social studies, or health). Subp. 4 enumerates 9 competency areas. Subp. 3 requires ACTFL advanced oral + advanced written, or schooling conducted in the target language. MTLE Bilingual exists but is not uniformly required for completers of MN-state-approved programs (PELSB Compliance Manual FY25, effective 2023-08-01).

eld.notes: Rule 8710.4400 — ESL is its own licensure field with its own student-teaching requirement. Subp. 3 enumerates 10 competency areas (A–J); subp. 3a requires ≥100 hrs field-based experience plus a 12-week full-time student-teaching placement spanning K–6, 5–8, and 9–12.

sei.notes: Rule 8710.2000 Standard 4.A names the MN English Language Development Standards Framework; all licensed teachers must understand it, but this does not rise to a sheltered-instruction mandate of the AZ/CA/MA/NV kind.

history.title: LEAPS Act enacted; state Seal of Biliteracy authorized
history.description: The Learning English for Academic Proficiency and Success (LEAPS) Act (2014 Minn. Laws ch. 272) reorganized Minnesota's EL framework and authorized the state Seal of Biliteracy. The seal language was subsequently codified at Minn. Stat. 120B.022 subd. 1b by 1Sp2015 c 3 art 2 s 2 and amended through 2024.

history.title: Rule 8710.2000 (Standards of Effective Practice) revised to name MN ELD Standards Framework
history.description: PELSB's revision of Rule 8710.2000 Standard 4.A explicitly names "Minnesota's English Language Development Standards Framework," strengthening the textual basis for `professionalStandardsMentions.el: true`. Standards 1.A, 1.D, 1.H, 1.I, 2.A, 4.E, 4.F, and 5.E carry diverse/cultural/linguistic language.

history.title: MTLE content/pedagogy/basic-skills tests no longer required for MN program completers
history.description: Per the PELSB FY25 Licensure Compliance Manual, completers of Minnesota-state-approved licensure programs are no longer required to pass MTLE content, pedagogy, or basic-skills tests effective 2023-08-01. This grounds `bilingual.requirements.test: null` and `eld.requirements.test: null`: the MTLE Bilingual and MTLE ESL exams exist but are not uniformly required.
